summary.headline: Inceptions and Interrogations
summary.text: Catalog of Florentine codex 5 chapters from folios 78v–82, listing astrological interrogations on thieves, friends and enemies, twelve-place inceptions, truth and reputation, pregnancies, illness and decumbitures, sterility, fornication, visitors’ purposes, difficult birth, miscarriage, and children’s learning. Cross-references are given to codex 7, with a note on a chapter also found in codex 92.
